scope: Three actual static UI concept boards, each with portrait and landscape plus a minimap expansion affordance

bounded_reference_preservation.scope: Visible concept structure and stylized identity compared with supplied original, not pixel identity, native asset, rig or runtime approval

repairs.original_defect: Excessive gloss/bevel, repeated large in-game HAVENLINE/Camp brand card; weak modernization over original.
repairs.observed_repair: Brand card removed; compact avatar/status bar; flatter surfaces and simpler analog joystick; dark type on apricot Build action; original camp composition and clear map expansion preserved.

repairs.original_defect: Double silver perimeter and raised/framed gray controls created a chrome-widget appearance.
repairs.observed_repair: Metal rims and bevels removed; matte charcoal rail/tray, quieter separators and flat primary action retained with the distinctive orientation reflow.

set_comparison.aurora: Cleanest contemporary light treatment and the most direct response to the modernization brief.
set_comparison.ember: Most structurally distinct; organized dark landscape rail becomes a portrait bottom tray.
set_comparison.alpine: Calmest and warmest presentation, with cream/sage grouping and dark-on-gold Build.

reviewer_preference.reason: Best fit to the explicit more-modern, simple and easy-to-read brief after the repair.
reviewer_preference.authority: Reviewer taste only; not an owner selection or implementation mandate

accepted_tradeoffs: Ember allocates a dedicated slice of landscape width to its rail; it still leaves the camp and routes visible.
Alpine intentionally retains soft, cozy rounded surfaces rather than the flatter visual language of Aurora.
Concept frame ratios are illustrative, not evidence of same-device orientation behavior.
scoring_rule: Minimum mandatory static-concept dimension must be strictly above 9.0, all scoped checks pass, target 10; no averaging. Bounded reference-preservation comparisons are separately scored 10 for every final direction. These are reviewer judgments, not mathematical similarity measures.
next_action: Present the three repaired concept choices with their differing strengths and scope limits. No further optional testing is needed for this static concept deliverable.
